result.title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors
result.comment: 100 pages (15 pages main text and references, 85 pages appendix), 78 figures, 68 tables. Extended version including supplementary material
result.summary: Earth-observation labels from maps, older products or hurried annotation arrive misaligned, coarse, loosely outlined or incomplete. Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) are nevertheless benchmarked with labels taken as correct. A practitioner therefore cannot tell which encoder to choose when the labels are imperfect. We present a benchmark protocol for fine-tuning under such labels. Four spatially structured error types are calibrated to equal label mIoU and applied identically to every model and seed. Every contrast is paired and read against an equivalence margin of $\pm 3$ points and a minimum detectable effect. We apply it to nine encoders, six decoder heads and ten datasets. In an exploratory reading at a matched learning rate the satellite-pretrained and web-pretrained DINOv3 encoders are equivalent within the margin on 8 of 9 datasets. Multispectral GFMs and an ImageNet ResNet-50 are equivalent within the margin on about half of them. Labels with random offsets cost the least at equal label quality. Under other decoder heads the verdicts mostly hold on FLAIR-2 and are decoder dependent on HLS Burn Scars. On four of five real label pairs the real label costs more than its matched simulated type. No choice of pretraining data makes an encoder consistently more robust, so the encoder is better chosen by its accuracy under imperfect labels.

AI.brief_summary: 提出在标签不完美条件下微调地理基础模型的基准协议：把四类空间结构化标注错误校准到相同标签 mIoU，统一施加于九个编码器、六个解码头和十个数据集，并以配对比较和 ±3 点等价边界给出判断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「等难度扰动校准＋配对对照＋等价边界」的评价设计可能可供核查，用于 LVR 中差异微小的变体比较与稳健性判定，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据使用。
